hints.title: Minimum Multiplier Fixing
hints.text: Sort the index pairs in descending order of nums2 so that each nums2[i] acts as the minimum factor.

hints.title: Top-k Selection of First Array
hints.text: Among all elements visited whose nums2 value is at least nums2[i], pick the k largest values from nums1.

hints.title: Priority Queue Element Replacement
hints.text: Maintain a min-oriented collection of size k holding the largest nums1 values, updating max score when size equals k.

hints.title: Sorted Multiplier Min-Heap Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def maxScore(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        pairs = sorted(zip(nums2, nums1), reverse=True)
        pq = []
        total = 0
        ans = 0
        for n2, n1 in pairs:
            heapq.heappush(pq, n1)
            total += n1
            if len(pq) > k:
                total -= heapq.heappop(pq)
            if len(pq) == k:
                ans = max(ans, total * n2)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting pairs takes O(n log n) and min-heap maintenance takes O(n log k).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all C(n, k) subsequences is combinatorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to store sorted pairs and heap.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts by nums2 descending to fix the minimum factor and maintains a min-heap of size k for nums1.
